criterion_source.criterion_title: ## B27. Пересмотр меняет идентичность задачи, а контекст остаётся прежним

bounded_source_delta.effect: If N6 selected advance and a stored cycle substrate context exists whose design_problem_ref differs from _problem_ref(revision.revised_problem), the action is replaced by blocked with cycle_substrate_context_reissue_required before the decision and next iteration are assembled.

observed_runtime_path: The focused B27 test uses a fixture N4 generator for cycle zero, then retains the default N4 port for a possible second dispatch but replaces its downstream generation function with a bounded context-boundary shim.
The actual JointSimulationPort performs the one first-cycle N5 call; that cycle retains a conditional value reference and result reference.
N6 changes the revised problem hash; the guard blocks before a second N4 dispatch or second N5 call.

The test serializes the typed GenerationCycleRun to a local JSON file and reads it back with GenerationCycleRun.from_persisted_payload, preserving revised-problem and stop-reason fields. This is a local typed history roundtrip, not shared durable history.
nonclaims: No valid second context is produced or admitted; the guard stops stale reuse and is not a context reissue producer.
The second default N4 generator is not run: the test boundary prevents external LLM and production-reference dependencies from being contacted.
The bounded result does not establish a shared persisted original/revised request history, a public/API/audit projection, or finding-wide B27 closure.
The adjacent B11 Core artifact-projection test is a separate consumer witness; its artifact-owner write failure is not evidence for or against B27.
N7 remains a separate finding and is not closed by this guard.
The two default-N8 horizon cases pass in the pre-guard 4bea aggregate, but no post-guard run re-executes that selector; the source delta is localized to GenerationCycleController._revise_node.

stale_context_comparison.basis: The runtime recomputes _problem_ref from revision.revised_problem and compares it to the active context design_problem_ref at the N6 advance boundary.

bounded_stop_and_history_assertions.basis: The focused test observes terminal blocked status, the exact stop reason, one generator dispatch, one real N5 call, changed problem hash, and typed local history readback.

r1_positive_control.basis: The removal receipt qualifies the path with generator dispatch [0,1], one real second-N4 context-boundary call, one N5 call, different context/problem hashes, and the exact mismatch exception.

positive_revised_context_producer.basis: No run admits a new context for the revised problem or completes a valid second cycle.

ordinary_second_default_n4_llm_execution.basis: The focused positive B27 test deliberately stops before external generation; R1 only removes the guard to reach the real context mismatch validator.

B27.basis: The source guard safely refuses stale-context advance, but no producer supplies a valid revised context and supported second iteration required by the original criterion.

limitations_and_next_owner: Keep B27 OPEN. The next positive witness needs an owner-admitted context bound to the revised problem, a permitted second N4/N5 path, changed basis bindings, and original/revised request history through the shared persistence owner.
Keep the bounded default-N4 second-boundary shim explicit; do not describe it as a complete second LLM generation.
The saved R1 expected falsifier proves the 12-line stop guard is exercised. It is not a positive closure case and is not an aggregate test PASS.
The B11 artifact-owner failure and three EMP-01 failures in the 4bea aggregate remain separate test outcomes; they are not assigned to B27.
Source reviewer: /root/simulation_grid; B27 state and producer assignment remain owned by /root.
Do not report the 4bea default-N8 cases as post-guard verification: they ran before the source change; the final focused candidate covers B27 plus adjacent B11 only.
